tasks.title: Repository Initialization & Dependencies
tasks.description: Initialize package.json, configure ES modules/CommonJS, set up executable entry point in package.json, and install required production dependencies.
action_items: Create package.json with name 'md2pdf' and version '1.0.0'.
Set 'bin' entry pointing to './bin/index.js'.
Install production dependencies: 'commander', 'marked', 'puppeteer'.
Install dev dependencies: 'jest' (or equivalent test runner).
tasks.acceptance_criteria: package.json contains all required dependencies and bin configuration.

tasks.title: Core Parsing Engine Implementation
tasks.description: Create the parser module that converts raw Markdown strings into standard HTML document strings.
action_items: Export a function `parseMarkdownToHtml(markdownString)`.
Use `marked` to convert Markdown content into HTML elements.
Wrap converted HTML in a valid HTML5 document structure (`<!DOCTYPE html><html><head></head><body>...</body></html>`).
Include basic CSS print resets in `<head>` to normalize body margins.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Module exports `parseMarkdownToHtml` and returns valid HTML string given standard Markdown input.

tasks.title: PDF Generation Engine Implementation
tasks.description: Create the async Puppeteer renderer module that accepts an HTML string and generates an A4 PDF buffer.
action_items: Export an async function `renderHtmlToPdf(htmlString)`.
Launch Puppeteer in headless mode (`headless: 'new'`).
Set page content with `page.setContent(htmlString, { waitUntil: 'networkidle0' })`.
Export PDF buffer using `page.pdf({ format: 'A4', margin: { top: '1in', right: '1in', bottom: '1in', left: '1in' } })`.
Ensure browser instance is closed safely in a `finally` block.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Function returns a non-empty Buffer object containing valid PDF binary data.

tasks.title: CLI Interface & Main Orchestration
tasks.description: Wire up Commander CLI options, handle file I/O operations, invoke parser and renderer, and save output file.
action_items: Create `bin/index.js` with `#!/usr/bin/env node` shebang.
Configure Commander arguments: `<input-file>` (required), `-o, --output <path>` (optional).
Implement file existence check in `src/index.js`. Exit with Code 1 if file does not exist.
Derive default output filename (replace `.md` extension with `.pdf`) if output flag is omitted.
Read target file, execute `parseMarkdownToHtml`, execute `renderHtmlToPdf`, and write buffer to target output path.
Catch exceptions, output useful error messages to `stderr`, and exit with appropriate error codes (1, 2, or 3).
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Running `node bin/index.js sample.md -o sample.pdf` generates a valid PDF file on disk.

tasks.title: Integration & Unit Test Suite
tasks.description: Create unit tests for the parser and integration tests for CLI file generation.
action_items: Write unit tests in `tests/parser.test.js` verifying Markdown heading, list, and code block conversions.
Write integration test in `tests/cli.test.js` that executes the CLI against a fixture `.md` file.
Verify that output `.pdf` file is created, non-empty, and clean up temporary test files post-run.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All test suite assertions pass when running `npm test`.
